title: Tridimensional
summary: Tridimensional is an Italian publishing company owned by Rainbow that oversaw the production and release of merchandise for Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers in Italy and Europe. Its most notable products include the 2009 Miniatures collection, and the Huntik Magazine comic book series. In Europe, their products were distributed by Panini.

full_text:
Tridimensional is an Italian publishing company owned by Rainbow that oversaw the production and release of merchandise for Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers in Italy and Europe. Its most notable products include the 2009 Miniatures collection, and the Huntik Magazine comic book series. In Europe, their products were distributed by Panini. 

== Products ==
*Huntik Magazine
*Miniatures (2009) 
*Sticker Album

== Sticker Album ==

In 2009, Panini released the Huntik Sticker Album, a collection of 216 stickers that could be stuck inside a large book containing details on the different Seekers and Titans.

'''Tridimensional''' is an Italian publishing company owned by Rainbow that oversaw the production and release of merchandise for [[Season 1]] of ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'' in Italy and Europe. Its most notable products include the 2009 ''[[Miniatures (2009)|Miniatures]]'' collection, and the ''[[Huntik Magazine]]'' comic book series. In Europe, their products were distributed by Panini. 

== Products ==
*[[Huntik Magazine]]
*[[Miniatures (2009)]] 
*Sticker Album

== Sticker Album ==
[[File:Huntik_Sticker_Album.png|right|250px]]
In 2009, Panini released the Huntik Sticker Album, a collection of 216 stickers that could be stuck inside a large book containing details on the different [[Seekers]] and [[Titans]].
